purpose: Source-authored predicate contract for custom Tower law profiles that require construct unit classification. This records authored construct identity semantics only; it does not prove live battle stack identity, hero party enumeration, spell-cast correlation, construct readiness state, or authorize gameplay mutation.
requiredRuntimeProof: live battle stack unit SID proof
construct classifier reaches consuming hook proof
spell cast to construct owner correlation proof
temporary summon or duplicate-stack handling proof
